criterion: Death in any region respawns at that region's checkpoint (never level start), with the loadout, cure and boss state of that checkpoint.
observation: Actual ordinary mortal death probes cover all nine regional/progress checkpoint states per tier, including research/cure and dispersal ready. All positions, loadouts, cure flags, boss HP and death states match the captured checkpoints. Separate cure/boss checks close the older parenthetical partial-coverage label in the location checks; those labels are not treated as evidence. Both native control state hashes match the original complete route.
method: Current native qa:accept both-tier complete/stationary + production fixtures/checkpoint controls; immutable source receipt snapshots.
